title: Blizzard beta development notes, 26 Oct 2026 (final racial pass)

records.notes: Published in Blizzard's WoW Forever Beta development notes; the notes describe the beta client. Whether the release client matches, and the in-game effective date and build, are not verified. Blizzard describes this as a final pass on racial abilities ahead of launch; weapon-specialization racials were deliberately not restored. The post was edited on 2026-10-27 (see that record).

set.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1%.

ops.summary: Critical strike bonus reduced from 2% to 1%.

previous.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.

ops.summary: Earth Fury (2% critical damage and healing) was removed.

set.name: Artisan's Precision
set.description: Increases your hit chance with spells and attacks by 1%.

ops.summary: New passive replacing Earth Fury: 1% hit chance with spells and attacks.

set.description: Grants 2% movement speed per stack the longer you stay moving, for a total of up to 60%. It does not increase mounted movement speed.

ops.summary: Bonus doubled to 2% per stack (60% maximum, was 30%), and it no longer works while mounted.

previous.description: Increases movement speed the longer you stay moving, and increases mounted movement speed by 3% (stacks with other mounted speed increases).

ops.summary: Now only grants the 5% Health bonus; the other modifiers were removed.

previous.description: Increases total Health by 5% and your critical strike bonus to damage and healing by 2%.

ops.summary: Savage (1% critical strike chance) was removed.

set.name: Command
set.description: Increases Warlock and Hunter pet damage by 5%.

ops.summary: Command is back (it is a Classic racial): Warlock and Hunter pets deal 5% more damage.

set.description: Increases melee, ranged and spellcasting Haste by 2%.

previous.description: Increases melee, ranged and spellcasting Haste by 3%.

set.description: Increases Mana and Health regeneration by 50%. Cannot be used while Innervate is active, and Innervate replaces it as the more powerful effect. Using it at a ley line also grants Attuned for 1 hour, which raises the regeneration bonus to 100% and persists through death.

ops.summary: Regeneration bonus halved to 50% for 15 seconds, with a stronger Attuned state at ley lines.

previous.description: Activate a ley line to gain 100% increased Health and Mana regeneration.

set.description: Increases movement speed by 15%. Using it at an elemental convergence also grants Charged for 1 hour, which raises the speed bonus to 30% and persists through death.

ops.summary: Speed bonus raised to 15% for 15 seconds, with a stronger Charged state at elemental convergences.

previous.description: Receive an Elemental Blessing that increases run speed by 10%.
